subject: Forecast traceability sprint — ARR evidence & bookings certification
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast traceability sprint — ARR evidence & bookings certification

Team —

Board packet deadline is 2027-05-02. Finance asked we surface a short, verifiable path from CRM stage to booking recognition for every commit in the ARR corridor. I want to run a two-day traceability sprint next week to: 

- lock down stage hygiene (no open docs, no ambiguous 'contracting')
- collect primary evidence (POs, signed SOWs, DocuSign links) for all committed deals > $25k
- produce a one-page evidence table per deal for the board packet

Please see the attached evidence-checklist.xlsx and the deal-trace-playbook.pdf for the simple acceptance criteria. My ask for each owner:

1) By EOD Monday (04/26): mark CRM stage as either "Commit - Board" or move to the correct stage; add the HubSpot deal link to the checklist.
2) By EOD Wednesday (04/28): upload required evidence to the shared Drive folder and flag in the checklist.

Marcus — you have two deals in the corridor; can you confirm owners and expected revenue recognition dates?
Vivek — can you coordinate with RevOps to freeze gating rules for the week of the sprint?
Laura — finance will want a quick reconciliation (bookings vs ARR movement) on Thursday. Can you block 30m?

I'll consolidate and circulate a final evidence bundle on Friday for review with legal and ops.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Senior Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-checklist.xlsx, deal-trace-playbook.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast traceability sprint — ARR evidence & bookings certification

Thanks Jasmine — good plan. Quick operational notes: 

- RevOps will apply a temporary stage-lock on Monday 04/26 between 9am–6pm PT to prevent mid-sprint edits (we'll record the lock window).
- I'll ask sales managers to add a single canonical deal owner in HubSpot (owner contact + backup).
- For any deals with deferred start dates we should capture the customer-signed SOW and the invoice schedule; if the SOW is outstanding, move the deal to "Contracting - At Risk".

Marcus — if you can drop the Mendrix material in the Drive folder (and include the PO or interim invoice), that will speed sign-off.

Vivek
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast traceability sprint — ARR evidence & bookings certification

On Sat, Apr 24, 2027 at 9:08 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jasmine — good plan. Quick operational notes:
> - RevOps will apply a temporary stage-lock on Monday 04/26 between 9am–6pm PT to prevent mid-sprint edits (we'll record the lock window).

All — uploaded Mendrix package to the shared Drive and attached a zipped packet here. Summary: 
- Mendrix: $48,000 ARR; signed SOW (pending final signature) + email confirmation from procurement. Expected revenue recognition: 2027-05-15 (first invoice).
- Halogen (smaller): $12,000 ARR; fully executed SOW and PO on file — ready to certify.

Attachment: Mendrix-deal-pack.zip

I'll mark Mendrix owner as myself in HubSpot and add the DocuSign placeholder. If we don't have the executed SOW by Wednesday, move Mendrix to "Contracting - At Risk" as Vivek suggested.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@atlaspay.com>

Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast traceability sprint — ARR evidence & bookings certification

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the heads up. Procurement looped me on the SOW — I just routed the signed copy via DocuSign (link below). We need to confirm the service start date for revenue recognition; our legal team says services begin on the execution date unless otherwise specified.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/secure/sign/3Xf7-AtlasPay-SOW

I've cc'd procurement@atlaspay.com to coordinate final billing cadence. Tell me what you need for the board packet and we'll get it in place.

— Susan

CFO, AtlasPay
procurement@atlaspay.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, procurement@atlaspay.com, Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@atlaspay.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast traceability sprint — ARR evidence & bookings certification

Team — quick consolidated plan and immediate asks: 

1) Stage freeze: RevOps will enact the lock Monday 04/26. Do not edit stage values during the lock period; if you must, log the rationale in the deal comments.
2) Owners: Marcus — Mendrix owner confirmed; Laura — can you reconcile Mendrix recognition date with finance (expected 2027-05-15)?
3) Evidence: Marcus / Marcus's backup — upload the Mendrix packet and flag the DocuSign link in the checklist. Susan — thanks for the DocuSign link; we'll snapshot the envelope for the board evidence pack.
4) Drive: I've created the evidence folder and one-page template here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF_finance_board_packet (fill the template and mark as "Ready for Review").

I'll run a 20-minute readout Thu 04/29 10:00am PT to confirm final reconciliation before packaging for legal. Calendar invite to follow. If any deal owner expects a gating change, escalate to Vivek immediately.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Jasmine Liu
Senior Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments in thread: evidence-checklist.xlsx, deal-trace-playbook.pdf, Mendrix-deal-pack.zip, atlaspay-signed-sow.pdf
